title: A Quantum Dynamics Tutorial: Visualising Dynamical Decoupling Sequences on the Bloch Sphere
summary: Dynamical decoupling protocols provide a versatile toolbox for robust control of quantum systems, suppressing noise that would otherwise limit their performance. This tutorial aims to provide an intuitive interpretation of these protocols. Written from an experimentalist's perspective, we use the Bloch sphere picture to visualise quantum dynamics for a range of sequences. Here each dynamical decoupling operation can be viewed as an "effective field vector", whilst the phase and population of the two-level system is encoded into a "Bloch vector".
